notes.title: Major Update #11 - Version 0.5.9
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Operation Athena – Major Update #11
[/b][/h1][p]We’ve pushed a new major update for Operation Athena, bringing weapon system refinements, map work, optimizations, and a massive leap forward in AI behavior with the introduction of the Tactical AI Coordinator.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Core Gameplay & Weapon Updates[/b][/h2][p]
[/p][p][b]Singleplayer Mode Returns:[/b] Singleplayer has been fully reintegrated into the main menu, allowing players to experience Operation Athena on their own. Explore maps, test tactics, and refine your skills without a squad. This mode ensures everyone can enjoy the game, whether practicing solo or experimenting with new loadouts and strategies.[/p][p][b]Weapon Adjustments:[/b] Recoil tuning, pistol improvements, and sparks added to gunfire for enhanced feedback.[/p][p][b]Animation System:[/b] New animation system restored and reintegrated with bypass code for stability.[/p][p][b]Reload & Running Fixes:[/b] Resolved a bug with reloading while sprinting, ensuring smoother gunplay flow.[/p][p][b]Gun Parent Updates:[/b] Core adjustments applied to weapon parent logic to better support new systems.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]AI & Tactical Systems[/b][/h2][p][b]Tactical AI Coordinator:
[/b]Enemy NPCs are now managed by the Tactical AI Coordinator, a new system that groups AI into squads for smarter, team-based behavior.[/p][list][*][p]Enemies can now take and hold cover rather than rushing blindly.

[/p][/*][*][p]AI better maintains tactical spacing, avoiding unrealistic clustering.

[/p][/*][*][p]Units will fall back defensively when under heavy fire.

[/p][/*][*][p]Coordinated movements create more realistic and intense combat scenarios, making encounters feel like you’re fighting against trained operators instead of isolated bots.

[/p][/*][/list][p]This system raises the bar for immersion and challenge across every level.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Map & Environment Work[/b][/h2][p][b]Woodlands Map:[/b] Continued work and quick push updates, including asset and texture refinements.[/p][p][b]Art Gallery:[/b] Hostage AI spawn fix applied, plus ongoing adjustments for balance.[/p][p][b]Sandstorm:[/b] Added an additional window plank to floor one as a ramp for additional environmental movement.[/p][p][b]Federal Building:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed 24 unnecessary windows for optimization.

[/p][/*][*][p]Security glass Nanite disabled for performance improvements.

[/p][/*][*][p]Windows reset with new default sleeping state settings.

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Optimization:[/b] Asset modifications and environmental refinements applied across multiple maps resulting in lowered VRAM usage and smaller game size.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]System & Code Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]Glass Optimization:[/b] Multiple glass objects streamlined to reduce GPU load.[/p][p][b]Field Master Actor:[/b] Now properly destroys after one second on creation, preventing lingering references.[/p][p][b]AI Spawn Logic:[/b] Tactical AI Coordinator integrated into AI spawn logic across all maps—AI spawns now plug directly into the system on creation.[/p][p][b]Gamepad Support:[/b] Partial controller support now available with additional button mappings. Continued work toward full support is underway.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Impact[/b][/h2][p]This update transforms how combat feels in Operation Athena. With the Tactical AI Coordinator, enemies act like cohesive squads, making firefights more engaging and tactical. Combined with weapon refinements, animation system updates, and continuous map improvements, the game is sharper, smarter, and more immersive than ever.[/p][p]🔥⚔️🎮 Thank you for your continued support and feedback—your playtesting drives these changes forward.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update 0.5.8a.1
notes.notes:
[p]This small hotfix addresses three issues reported after the 0.5.8a update: [/p][h3]Fixes
[/h3][list][*][p][b]Audio Bug[/b] – Fixed the running sound continuing to play if a player was killed while sprinting.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Targeting Update[/b] – Improved how AI acquire player targets. A new [b]Actor is now spawned on the player’s head socket[/b], and upon spawn it calls a message to [b]Storage[/b] to correctly store and track the target actor.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Death Behavior[/b] – Fixed an issue where AI would continue firing at a player’s last position after death. AI now correctly stop engaging when a player dies.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We wanted to push this fix out as quickly as possible to keep your experience smooth and consistent. Thanks for continuing to test, report, and help shape [i]Operation Athena[/i]. ❤️🎮[/p]

notes.title: Major Update #9 - Version 0.5.8
notes.notes:
[p]Hey, Operators![/p][p]We’re excited to share a massive update for [i]Operation Athena[/i], incorporating extensive playtesting feedback, system overhauls, and a variety of fixes and optimizations. This patch touches every corner of the game—from gameplay and AI to homebase systems, level design, weapons, and environmental systems.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Core Gameplay & Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New XP & Gamestats Systems:[/b] Fully integrated Player XP component with a revamped, weighted Gamestats system. Player performance is now dynamically graded (S, A, B, C, D, F). Players can earn levels through completing missions based on mission grades. Current level is visible in both the main menu and homebase.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Up SFX:[/b] Level up music plays at mission end [b]only if a player levels up[/b] by gaining enough XP based on their grade upon mission success. If the player does not level up, the [b]normal Mission Success music plays as usual[/b].

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Destructible/Interactive Lights:[/b] Lights replaced on all maps and can be destroyed; deprecated light-switch lights removed on Killhouse. 

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing & Input Fixes:[/b] Conflicts between the healing key (H) and grenade input have been resolved. Healing widgets now disappear correctly after use.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon & Ammo Updates:[/b] Gunner and Breacher Special Item ammo supply counters added and reload sounds/fixes integrated. Shotgun skeleton adjustments, overall gun logic fixes and various improvements.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Metahumans: Upgraded to 5.5[/b] for hostages and some NPCs.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]C4 Explosive – Major Breacher Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Addition:[/b] C4 is now fully integrated as a key tool for the Breacher class.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Cascade:[/b] A [b]grenade detonation[/b] will also detonate a [b]placed C4[/b] within its blast radius, adding tactical synergy.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Enhancements:[/b] Breacher C4 ammo counter added via custom BPI, fully integrated with weapon UI.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blast Behavior:[/b] C4 explosions are now more realistic, sending blasts forward into rooms and potentially eliminating enemies in cover near the radius. Doors react correctly when breached with C4.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]AI & Level Systems[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]AI Spawn Director:[/b] Dynamic NPC spawning now works 100% using the Spawn Level Director. Enemies are no longer static variables but use dynamic arrays for more flexible encounters. Five default enemies per level are set, with full control over spawn quantity and type.

[/p][/*][*][p]Using the new [b]Director Spawner[/b], AI on various levels are now unique to each location and [b]thematically matched[/b] to the environments.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI Behavior & Visuals:[/b] Adjustments made to AI visuals and behavior; flanking, and engagement tactics improved.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level & Map Optimization:[/b] Multiple map updates, including Art Gallery, Homebase, Sandstorm, Killhouse, Villa, and Highrise, updated lighting, and optimized assets.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Lighting & Environmental Interactions[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Lighting System:[/b] Players can now interact with light switches, shoot out lights, or even turn off the power entirely in some buildings.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environmental Interactions:[/b] Doors and lights updated for player interaction and destructibility. Collision adjustments, door lock icon bug fixes, and interaction object optimizations have been made to ensure gameplay is smooth and immersive.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Homebase & UI Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Homebase Enhancements:[/b] Intelligence room updated for engagement and visual polish. Player stats widgets now update as each player joins the lobby, with 3D XP visualization integrated.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu & Main UI:[/b] Main menu now shows player XP and level progress before joining or starting a lobby. Weapon options and homebase assets have been refined.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Stats Displays:[/b] Player stats widgets in Homebase [b]update as each player joins[/b]. Added [b]3D player level widget[/b] to Homebase.

[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Weapon Systems Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ammo & UI Counters:[/b] Gunner ammo supply and Breacher C4 UI counters added to player UI.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Misc Weapon Fixes:[/b] Burst removed from SMG7 and recoil adjusted for multiple guns.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]UMD45 SMG:[/b] Added to the arsenal, providing a new primary weapon option for close-quarters and tactical engagements.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pistol Laser Attachment:[/b] Now available, improving hip-fire accuracy and target acquisition in close quarters.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]General:[/b] Misc weapon fixes; fire modes corrected; continued integration of all guns with the updated animation systems.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Stealth & Suppressed Weapons (New Addition)[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Silenced Systems Overhaul:[/b] Suppressed weapons now [b]reduce sound propagation and wall penetration[/b], making stealth approaches more viable. This is also further affected by weapon type and caliber.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Sidearm Option:[/b] [b]Suppressed Mock 18[/b] added to loadouts, enabling confident silent takedowns.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Visuals, Materials & Effects[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Master Material Updates:[/b] Steel Metal Material warnings fixed, Nanite enabled for some assets, and master material adjustments completed.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting Overhaul:[/b] Nearly all lights across every map have now been upgraded to the new [b]breakable and interactable system[/b]. This means players can toggle, shoot out, or fully destroy lights to change the flow of engagements. Just a few finishing touches remain before the rollout is complete on all maps![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer & Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Discord Rich Presence plugin integrated.

[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for spectator UI, late joins, and multiplayer replication issues.

[/p][/*][*][p]Continuous bug fixes across levels, AI, animations, assets, and gameplay systems.

[/p][/*][*][p]Asset optimizations, map work, and minor tweaks to improve overall performance and stability.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Art Gallery, Homebase, Sandstorm, Killhouse, Villa, Highrise, Woodlands[/b]—broad updates and optimization.

[/p][/*][*][p]Chromatic aberration screen effect no longer hangs after player respawn.

[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs opening locked doors now properly remove the lock.

[/p][/*][*][p]AI no longer fires at the player’s weapon after player death.

[/p][/*][*][p]Player freezing on death implemented (consistent with AI freeze behavior).

[/p][/*][*][p]Hospital map removed for reworks.

[/p][/*][*][p]And much more…[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This update represents one of the [b]most comprehensive patches for [i]Operation Athena[/i][/b] to date—touching XP progression, stealth, explosives, AI, lighting, weapons, UI, and performance. The [b]new C4 system[/b] empowers Breachers with true tactical demolition, while the [b]stealth overhaul (Silenced Sound/Penetration)[/b] and [b]interactive lighting[/b] let squads shape the battlefield on their terms.

[/p][p][b]We’re cooking up more content and improvements—when it’s ready, you’ll get it. Simple as that. 🎯🔫💥🕵️⚡🏠[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.5.7 - AI Enhancements
notes.notes:
This update focuses on refining AI behavior to improve overall game feel and realism. While smaller in scope, these changes make a significant impact on gameplay immersion and challenge.

[h2]AI Improvements & Adjustments[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]More Realistic Reaction Times: [/b]AI now responds to player actions at a more natural and balanced speed, reducing instances of near-instant reactions.
[*] [b]Smoother AI Rotation: [/b]AI no longer snaps too quickly when tracking players, making enemy movement and aiming feel more fluid and human-like.
[*] [b]Overall AI Feel Improved: [/b]Movement, engagement, and responsiveness have been fine-tuned to enhance tactical depth and player immersion.
[/list]
This update is an important step toward making AI combatants feel more authentic and engaging. Expect further refinements in future updates! 🤖🎯🔥

notes.title: Update #8 - Version 0.5.6
notes.notes:
Spring is here, the sun is shining, and with it comes one of our biggest updates yet! This update brings massive AI improvements, enhanced visuals, new gameplay features, and major performance upgrades. Enemies now fight smarter than ever, using better cover mechanics, improved flanking strategies, and more precise shooting. Plus, Unreal Engine 5.5 integration delivers improved performance, lighting, and reflections.

New intro movie to replace old intro screen.

[h1]Engine & Graphics Updates (UE 5.5 Integration)[/h1]

[h3]Lumen & Rendering Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Lumen HWRT optimizations ensure better performance while maintaining high visual fidelity. 
[*] Improved Lumen Global Illumination (GI) and reflections.
[*] New hit-lighting for GI, offering a more accurate way to calculate GI and reducing the limitations of static meshes.
[*] Updated reflection denoiser, significantly improving sharpness in low roughness reflections and enhancing translucent surfaces with refraction in reflections.
[/list]

[h3]New Scene Capture & Render Pass Capabilities:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Scene captures and custom render passes now mirror the main view’s camera and resolution.
[*] Includes support for temporal AA jitter and screen percentage adjustments.
[/list]

[h3]AMD FSR 3.1 Support:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved upscaling image quality, reducing flickering, shimmering, and ghosting.
[*] Selectable Anti-Aliasing (AA) options unlocked:
FXAA, TSAA, TSR are no longer locked to TSR.
[*] Quality settings for each option can be adjusted.
[*] FSR 3.1 fully integrated – TSAA or TSR recommended for higher-end hardware.
[/list]

[h1]AI Overhaul - Smarter, Harder, More Tactical[/h1]

[b]The AI has been significantly upgraded, making enemy combatants more aggressive, intelligent, and reactive to player movement and cover mechanics.[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved AI Accuracy: AI aims better and lands more shots, making engagements more intense.
[*] Better Cover Usage: Enemies now properly hold and use cover, moving between positions instead of blindly rushing.
[*] Flanking & Tactical Movement: AI is more likely to strafe, flank, and reposition, making them much harder to predict.
[*] Enhanced Defensive Behaviors: AI now works together, supporting teammates rather than rushing into danger alone.
[/list]
[h3]Major Line-of-Sight Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] AI can now correctly see through glass doors (previously, they couldn't).
[*] Fixed AI shooting through edges when acquiring targets around corners.
[*] AI will now react appropriately when spotting you through transparent surfaces.
[*] Fixed Guard AI Targeting Issues.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Fixes & Enhancements[/h1]

[h3]Night Vision System Overhaul:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Reworked night vision system to better reflect real-world functionality.
[*] Dynamic adjustments to varying lighting conditions.
[*] Realistic visual noise for a more immersive experience.
[*] Newly designed widget overlay for improved usability.
[/list]

[h1]UI & Interaction Updates:[/h1]

[h3]Door Interaction and UI:[/h3]

[list]
[*] "Kick Door" text now turns red when within kicking distance.
[*] Fixed doors no longer playing an open sound when kicked open.
[/list]

[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed player healing while already being healed by a medic.
[*] Fixed hand location on the weapon after canceling self-healing.
[/list]

[h3]Weapon & Projectile Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Gun projectile improvements: Glass breaking is now more consistent and accurately reacts to bullet impacts.
[*] Adjusted glass sound attenuation for more realistic spatial sounds.
[*] New glass sounds implemented for all windows.
[/list]

[h3]Environmental Fixes & Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Buoy in Villa now properly destroys when shot or hit with a grenade.
[*] Fixed door destruction mechanics: Adjusted damage thresholds, ensuring doors with windows break more realistically.
[*] Fixed navigation issues on Federal Building: Hostages can now properly navigate the front area.
[*] Fixed flare and character run sound replication issues.
[*] Cleaned up and rebalanced audio in general
[/list]

[h3]Nanite Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed shadow flickering issues on chest rigs.
[*] Various Skeletal Meshes set to Nanite now
[/list]

This update marks a huge leap in AI Behaviors, game polish, and performance. As we move forward, expect more improvements, new content, and exciting updates as the world of the game continues to evolve.

Enjoy the warmer weather and longer days—more to come soon!🌞🔥

notes.title: Update #6 - Version 0.5.4
notes.notes:
This update refines AI behaviors, improves gameplay mechanics, and addresses key bugs for a smoother, more immersive experience. Enjoy enhanced AI cover usage, realistic fleeing speeds, and polished UI elements.

[h2]AI IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]

[h3]Acceptance Radius Fix:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Corrected an oversight in the AI "Move to Attack Ranged" function. Previously, the acceptance radius was only 50 unreal units, causing AI to abandon cover and run directly to the player.
[*] The radius has been increased to 1000 unreal units, allowing AI to hold cover and engage in combat from a distance or move strategically between covers.
[/list]

[h3]Line of Sight Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed AI line-of-sight checks from a sphere to a capsule for better accuracy.
[*] Capsule dimensions adjusted to radius: 2 and half-height: 2, improving AI behavior when shooting from around corners or cover.
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Behavior Tweaks:
[/h3]

[list]
[*] Lowered enemy fleeing speed from 600 to 300 for more realistic movement when retreating.
[*] Fixed issues with doors not affecting the nav mesh when open, which previously caused bad AI behaviors and navigation problems.
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY FIXES:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the lock icon on doors floating in place after the doors were destroyed.
[/list]
[h2]
GAME UI & HINTS:[/h2]

[h3]Added a Game Hints Controls Popup Widget:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Displays hints and control mappings during gameplay.
[*] Option to enable/disable game control hints in the Options Menu.
[/list]

[h3]Options Menu Enhancements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Refined spacing and alignment for various titles, resulting in a cleaner and more organized interface.
[/list]

This patch brings significant AI behavior improvements and usability enhancements, ensuring a more immersive and polished experience. Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Update #3 - Version 0.5.1
notes.notes:
[h1]FEATURES:[/h1]

Added Team Grading system, allowing players to receive a team grade based on cooperation with other players.

Introduced player-specific stat tracking component, recording stats such as total damage dealt, kills, damage received, headshots, and mission completion time. Includes integrated timing controls and Blueprint functionality for real-time updates.

Added lock icon with new billboard material and distance fade to doors. Players can now easily see when doors are locked as they approach them.

Inclusion of the WIP B36C weapon for the Teamlead Class.

Homebase radio has been updated to feature WIP original songs instead of royalty-free tracks.

[h1]FIXES/CHANGES:[/h1]

Fixed Single Player F10 functionality where the player couldn’t properly respawn and select a new class at Homebase.

The F10 input is now editable in the Controls Options menu, allowing players to customize it for changing classes.

Fixed issues with the mouse appearing on screen when spawning into a mission or respawning.

Resolved issues with client-side weapon locker loadout selection, ensuring selected guns load correctly when spawning into a mission.

Resolved issues with the End Screen UI for both failure and success states, ensuring proper functionality of the music and UI elements.

Addressed enemy count visibility for clients, ensuring all players now see the correct terrorist mode enemy count at the end of the mission.

Reworked scoring system and mission end screen logic, ensuring that all players receive a score and various stats upon mission success or failure.

Replicated enemy count for all clients, ensuring accurate data is displayed for all players during mission completion.

Finalized and improved grading and scoring system with enhanced HUD changes.

Fixed issues where the late join of a client caused enemy count issues from previous updates.

[h1]WEAPON/ANIMATION CHANGES:[/h1]

Adjusted SMR416 dynamic animation to properly hit the bolt release.

Adjusted SARL reload animation to prevent the magazine mesh from clipping through the firearm during reloads.

Adjusted SEG MCS dynamic animation to properly hit the bolt release.

Added a WIP reload animation for the SO-58, along with other dynamic animation adjustments.

Lowered the gunfire volume for the SMG7.

Adjusted M4 URGI dynamic animation to properly hit the bolt release.

Adjusted PK-18 dynamic animation to properly hit the bolt release.

Added a laser device to the Standard M4A1 weapon preset.

This update introduces a variety of fixes and features, including new animations, original music tracks, a new weapon, and improved gameplay functionality. Thank you for your feedback and continued support as we refine the experience!
